title: His father's hotel job and the family's cooking
summary: His father supervised menus for Gulf hotels and was a baker; the brothers cook.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, this hasn't much bearing, really, on our story, but I've wondered how late was your father living? When did he die, about?
When did he die? I don't remember.
Oh, yeah, he died before my mother.
Before when your mother died, when you were just joining... That's...
Yeah. When did my father die? 19... I had to have someone.
Did he play professionally, or did he have another job, or what did he do? Who? Your father.

My father was the hotel... Hotel... The... Of all the Mexican Gulf hotels. He made up all the menus. Oh, was that right? He did the buying. He had a pretty good job. Mm-hmm. And all his menus, all his recipes were used in all the Mexican Gulf hotels in the Southern Territory. Right. He supervised them. He was a hell of a baker. Ooh, brother. What a baker that man was.
That's why we all learned how to cook. Richie was a good cook. I cook fairly well. Abby's a wonderful cook. My sister, my other brother Richie, was working on the coil boats.
He was cooking for the crew, and they went crazy for his food.
Richie's in a bad way now.
